maddeler.e:
نتساوم (form VI)
# نَتَسَاوَمُ (natasāwamu) /na.ta.saː.wa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
# نَتَسَاوَمَ (natasāwama) /na.ta.saː.wa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
# نَتَسَاوَمْ (natasāwam) /na.ta.saː.wam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَاوَمَ (tasāwama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
